title.en: Properties of the mean; combined and weighted means
title.kn: ಮಾಧ್ಯದ ಗುಣಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು; ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಮತ್ತು ತೂಕಸಹಿತ ಮಾಧ್ಯ

hook.en: Section A (40 students) averaged 62 and Section B (60 students) averaged 52. Is the college average 57? No: the bigger section pulls harder.
hook.kn: ವಿಭಾಗ A (40 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು) ಸರಾಸರಿ 62, ವಿಭಾಗ B (60 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು) ಸರಾಸರಿ 52. ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಸರಾಸರಿ 57 ಅಲ್ಲ: ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿಭಾಗ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: State the properties of the arithmetic mean
Find the combined mean of two groups
List the merits and demerits of the mean

narration.en: Section A (40 students) averaged 62 and Section B (60 students) averaged 52. Is the college average 57? No: the bigger section pulls harder.
narration.kn: ವಿಭಾಗ A (40 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು) ಸರಾಸರಿ 62, ವಿಭಾಗ B (60 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳು) ಸರಾಸರಿ 52. ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಸರಾಸರಿ 57 ಅಲ್ಲ: ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿಭಾಗ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಎಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: (1) The sum of deviations from the mean is zero: $\sum (x - \bar{x}) = 0$. (2) The sum of squared deviations is least when taken from the mean. (3) Combined mean of two groups: $\bar{x}_{12} = (n_1\bar{x}_1 + n_2\bar{x}_2)/(n_1 + n_2)$. (4) Adding a constant k to every value adds k to the mean; multiplying every value by k multiplies the mean by k.
body.kn: (1) ಮಾಧ್ಯದಿಂದ ವಿಚಲನಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ ಶೂನ್ಯ. (2) ವಿಚಲನ ವರ್ಗಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ ಮಾಧ್ಯದಿಂದ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ. (3) ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಮಾಧ್ಯ = (n₁x̄₁ + n₂x̄₂)/(n₁ + n₂). (4) ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ k ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ ಮಾಧ್ಯಕ್ಕೂ k ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: (1) The sum of deviations from the mean is zero: sum of  (x - x-bar) = 0. (2) The sum of squared deviations is least when taken from the mean. (3) Combined mean of two groups: x-bar12 = (n1x-bar1 + n2x-bar2)/(n1 + n2). (4) Adding a constant k to every value adds k to the mean; multiplying every value by k multiplies the mean by k.

title.en: Deviations from the mean balance out

say.en: Values 4, 6, 8, 10, 12. Their mean is 40 over 5, that is 8.
Deviations from 8: minus 4, minus 2, 0, plus 2, plus 4. They add to zero.
Combined mean of two sections: weight each mean by its size.

narration.en: On the board: Deviations from the mean balance out.

body.en: When items differ in importance, give each a weight w: $\bar{x}_w = \sum wx / \sum w$ (used for index numbers and results with credits). Merits of the mean: rigidly defined, easy to compute, based on all observations, capable of algebraic treatment, least affected by sampling fluctuations. Demerits: badly affected by extreme values, cannot be found for open-end classes without assumptions, may not be an actual value (2.65 children), unsuitable for qualitative data.
body.kn: ಮಹತ್ವ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ತೂಕ w ನೀಡಿ: x̄w = Σwx/Σw. ಗುಣಗಳು: ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಾದ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯೆ, ಎಲ್ಲ ವೀಕ್ಷಣೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಧಾರ, ಬೀಜಗಣಿತ ಬಳಕೆ. ದೋಷಗಳು: ತೀವ್ರ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿತ, ತೆರೆದ ತುದಿ ವರ್ಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಷ್ಟ.

problem.en: A student's marks: Statistics 80 (credit weight 4), Maths 70 (3), English 60 (2), Kannada 90 (1). Find the weighted mean and compare it with the simple mean.

steps.en: Simple mean = (80 + 70 + 60 + 90) ÷ 4 = 75. The weights pull it towards the more important subjects.

Section A: 40 students, mean 60. Section B has mean 70. How many students in B make the combined mean 65?

prompt.en: Section A: 40 students, mean 60. Section B has mean 70. How many students in B make the combined mean 65?

hint.en: Combined mean = total marks / total students.

explanation.en: x̄ = (n₁x̄₁ + n₂x̄₂)/(n₁ + n₂): 65 lies midway, so the groups are equal: n₂ = 40.

points.en: Σ(x − x̄) = 0; Σ(x − x̄)² is minimum.
The mean uses all values but is hurt by extremes.
points.kn: ಮಾಧ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ತೀವ್ರ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿತ.

homework.en: The mean wage of 50 workers in factory A is ₹600 and of 70 workers in factory B is ₹540. Find the combined mean wage.

narration.en: Recap. Σ(x − x̄) = 0; Σ(x − x̄)² is minimum. Combined mean = (n₁x̄₁ + n₂x̄₂)/(n₁ + n₂). Weighted mean = Σwx/Σw. The mean uses all values but is hurt by extremes.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. Σ(x − x̄) = 0; Σ(x − x̄)² ಕನಿಷ್ಠ. ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಮಾಧ್ಯ = (n₁x̄₁ + n₂x̄₂)/(n₁ + n₂). ತೂಕಸಹಿತ ಮಾಧ್ಯ = Σwx/Σw. ಮಾಧ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ತೀವ್ರ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಭಾವಿತ.
